cases.query: When should I return after discharge for uncontrolled blood sugars?

clinical_recommendation.text: Return within the documented follow-up window and seek urgent review if red-flag symptoms develop.

cases.query: Can I stop the new medication if I feel fine now?

clinical_recommendation.text: Escalate to a clinician because medication changes require review of the discharge plan.
